## Our church

Establish a Technology Stewardship team; map the congregation's tech skills and match them to needs; draft a church-wide ethical technology policy grounded in biblical principle and humane-tech practice; pair tech-savvy youth with elders for two-way mentoring; develop a digital missions strategy; and commit to open-sourcing ministry resources for the wider Body.
